notice.title: Legal notice
notice.description: Legal notice and owner information for {site} under article 10 of the LSSI.
notice.ownerIntro: In compliance with article 10 of Spanish Law 34/2002 on information society services and electronic commerce (LSSI), you are informed that the owner of this website is:
notice.purpose: {site} offers guidance information on vehicle recalls published in Safety Gate, the European Union rapid alert system, with a search by make, model and campaign.
notice.unofficial: This site is independent. It is not an official website of the European Commission, of any vehicle manufacturer or of any public authority. The information is for guidance only and does not replace the notice that the manufacturer sends to the vehicle owner or the original Safety Gate record, which is the only source with official value.
notice.data: The data come from Safety Gate (European Commission) and are reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU on the reuse of documents. The descriptions of the danger and of the measures are shown in the original language in which they were recorded.
notice.liability: The owner strives to keep the data correct and up to date, but does not guarantee their accuracy or validity. The owner is not responsible for decisions taken or for any damage arising from the use of the information. If your vehicle may be subject to a recall, check the data with the manufacturer, with your dealer or with the original Safety Gate record.

Reproduction, distribution or transformation without express permission is not allowed, except for personal use and citing the source. Safety Gate data are governed by the reuse conditions of the European Commission.
notice.links: The site may link to third-party pages, such as Safety Gate. The owner does not control those sites and is not responsible for their content or policies.
notice.law: This notice is governed by Spanish law. Any dispute will fall under the jurisdiction of the courts and tribunals that are competent under the applicable rules.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How {site} processes personal data under the GDPR.
privacy.dataIntro: This website has no forms or user accounts. The search runs in your browser: what you type is not sent to any server.
privacy.dataTheme: Light or dark theme: your choice is saved in your browser's local storage (ododex-theme). It stays on your device and is not sent to any server.
privacy.dataEmail: Email: if you write to us, we use your message and your address to reply. The legal basis is legitimate interest or your request.
privacy.dataLogs: Server logs: the hosting provider may record the IP address and technical data of the visit for security reasons. The legal basis is legitimate interest.
privacy.dataAds: Advertising: if enabled, we use Google AdSense (Google Ireland Ltd.), which may set cookies and process device data only if you give your consent. See the cookie policy.
privacy.transfers: Google may transfer data to the United States. It does so under the European Commission's standard contractual clauses and, where applicable, under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
privacy.retention: Emails are kept for as long as needed to handle your request and, afterwards, for the legal periods of possible liability. Server logs are kept according to the hosting provider's policy. Advertising data depend on Google and on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
privacy.rights: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability by writing to {email}, stating the right you are exercising. You can withdraw your consent at any time with the "Cookie settings" button in the footer, if it is available.
privacy.complaints: If you believe your rights have been infringed, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD):

cookies.description: Which cookies and local storage {site} uses and how to manage them.
cookies.what: Cookies and similar technologies (such as the browser's local storage) save small pieces of data on your device. They are regulated by article 22.2 of the LSSI and by the AEPD guide on the use of cookies.
cookies.themePurpose: Remember the light or dark theme you choose.
cookies.adsPurpose: Advertising and measurement. They are only set if you accept in the consent message.

cookies.change: You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" button in the footer. The button only appears when advertising is active.
